# CROSSTALK

> A cooperative bomb-defusal game for one human and one AI agent, built natively on WebMCP.
> The human sees the device (wire colors, glyphs, gauges, beeps) and has the hands.
> The agent holds the technical manual, the RFID scanner and the servo actuators —
> exposed as WebMCP tools on document.modelContext. Neither player can win alone.

## For agents visiting this page

- Call `get_briefing` first: it explains your role, the etiquette, and the mission list.
- `get_device_state` marks exactly what you can and cannot sense. Anything labeled
  "NOT machine-readable" must be read aloud by your human partner — ask, don't guess.
- Tools appear and vanish with game state (per-tool AbortSignals): sensors are annotated
  read-only; cutting, locking and transmitting are irreversible, so confirm before acting.
